svg.title: 0x00F6 — animated terminal banner
svg.desc: A terminal window types `cargo run --release`, prints cargo build output, then boots a glitching neon 0x00F6 title and the tagline “Building things that probably didn't need to be this fast.” A side pane shows a pixel-art crab and a stream of encrypted TLS and QUIC bytes being decoded into HTTP requests.

g.text: Building things that probably didn't need to be this fast.
